title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28.1): Use enhanced and faster reports for analysis of deferrals and trial balances
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 introduces enhanced deferral and trial balance reports with faster Excel layouts, new subtotals for easier reconciliation, and analysis views for improved financial data filtering and period-end task efficiency.
key_points: Built-in deferral report Excel layouts now include subtotals to make balance reviews easier during reconciliation and audit processes
Multiple standard finance Excel reports run significantly faster, helping finance teams analyze data and complete period-end tasks
New analysis views on GL Registers and Fixed Assets Ledgers list pages enable improved filtering and slicing of ledger and asset activity
Several sales Excel reports also received subtotal enhancements including Salesperson Commission and Customer/Item Sales

quotes.text: Built-in deferral report Excel layouts now include subtotals, making it easier to review balances.
quotes.why_it_matters: Directly improves the reconciliation and audit process by reducing manual spreadsheet work and enhancing transparency

quotes.text: Several standard finance Excel reports also run significantly faster, helping finance teams analyze data and complete period-end tasks more efficiently.
quotes.why_it_matters: Performance improvements enable faster financial analysis and decision-making during critical period-end processes

quotes.text: New analysis views on key finance list pages provide improved filtering and slicing of ledger and asset activity.
quotes.why_it_matters: Enhanced filtering capabilities strengthen financial oversight and support more informed decision-making
